about_short_description.short_description: Otrium is an online fashion outlet marketplace which tech-enables designer brands to turn unsold inventory into an opportunity,

product.name: Otrium Online Fashion Outlet Marketplace
product.description: A digital platform enabling designer brands to sell unsold inventory directly to consumers through an online outlet store.

product.name: Data-Made Fashion
product.description: A data-driven approach that uses customer insights to create fashion items that better match demand, reducing unsold inventory and fabric waste.

product.name: Inventory Polishing and Refurbishment Services
product.description: Services that prepare unsold or returned fashion items for resale by cleaning, repairing, photographing, and repackaging them.

product.name: Brand Partner Online Outlet Channel
product.description: A customizable online outlet store for fashion brands to sell excess inventory while maintaining control over brand presentation and pricing.

product.name: Sustainability and ESG Reporting Support
product.description: Tools and data services that help fashion brands track, report, and improve their environmental and social governance related to unsold inventory.
